name: finetune-data-collector
description: Collect human corrections and accepted edits as SFT and preference/DPO training records.

finetuneCollector.outputDirectory.description: Directory relative to the workspace root where records are written.

finetuneCollector.autoTrackEdits.description: Track saved human edits as candidate feedback sessions.

languageModelTools.name: finetuneCollector_recordFeedback
languageModelTools.userDescription: Save a real human correction or accepted result as SFT/preference training data.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use after the user clearly corrects, rejects, selects, accepts, or materially edits an AI-produced answer or patch. Preserve real candidates verbatim. Never invent rejected candidates. One independent decision per record.

taskType.description: For example code_edit, prose_edit, code_review, bug_fix, refactor, false_positive.
